newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Vocaltec, Samsung in cooperation talks - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Vocaltec, Samsung in cooperation talks - newspaper.

text.p: Israel's Vocaltec Inc and South Korea's Samsung Electronics are in talks on cooperating in technology, the Israeli newspaper Haaretz reported on Tuesday.
The newspaper said the talks are in the early stage but began several months ago.
Vocaltec officials could not immediately be reached for comment on the report.
A Samsung delegation headed by Min Hyung Chung, a senior manager at Samsung Electronics, and Jong Goo Lee, the head of the company's technology group, visited Israel last week.
Samsung is considering setting up a research and development centre in Israel, the Israel Export Institute said.
The delegation visited companies specialising in telecommunications, multimedia, software and semiconductors.
Vocaltec is a leading maker of Internet communications software. Its Internet Phone allows Internet users to make phone calls over their computers without long-distance charges.
